name: Multi-sample Transfer Function for Material Classification
aliases: Multi-sample transfer function for lighting and opacity
definition: Using the sample's scalar value and additional scalar values read along the gradient direction to specify color and opacity, allowing classification of voxels at transitions between materials with similar densities.
summary: Multi-sample Transfer Function for Material Classification classifies volume data by using scalar values from both sides of a material boundary to prevent misclassification at transitions between similar densities.
